description: Use this when get_setup_status says next_step is add_resume. Pass exactly one of: resume, the file the user attached, if you can attach files to tool calls; or resume_text, the content of their CV as you can read it, or the work history, education and skills the user tells you. Never invent or embellish anything. Returns suggested, the values to show the user next. Only for a first setup: another file replaces the one added before it; text cannot replace a file. Needs an AIApply account: if the user has not signed in, calling it asks them to sign in or create one. It also needs a permission the user grants; if it was not granted, calling it asks the user to allow it.

resume.description: The resume file the user attached (PDF or DOCX, at most 5 MB). Omit when sending resume_text.

resume_text.description: The resume as text, at most 30,000 characters. Omit when sending resume.

name: add_resume

added.description: True when the resume was added.

reason.description: Why nothing was added, when nothing was.

suggested.description: Values read from the resume, for the user to confirm.

user_message.description: Show this to the user rather than message.

title: Add a resume to AIApply
